info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v2-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Decline Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage the deletion of declined credit card applications. This endpoint allows for the removal of records for applications that have been declined, ensuring that data is kept current and relevant. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and credit service providers looking to streamline their application processing workflow. By maintaining clean and accurate records, organizations can enhance operational efficiency and improve customer service.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to decline an application by sending a DELETE request. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to perform this action, as it will remove the application from further consideration.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to decline an application. It must include the necessary information required to process the decline.

206.description: Partial content returned indicating the operation is in progress.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: Represents the request body for declining an application operation using DELETE method. This schema is intended to provide the necessary information as a plain string.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.title: Application Decline Response

status.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the application decline.

resultId.description: The ID of the result pertaining to the decline operation.

state.description: The current state of the application after the decline operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the decline operation, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the decline operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the decline operation.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.description: This schema defines the response structure for an application decline operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the audit entry.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the audit entry was created automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit details of the decline operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
